cmd:
set -euo pipefail
O=/workspace/keep/sift-100k
mkdir -p $O
K=/workspace/keep
# name|checkpoint|config  -- config may come from the repo checkout for runs
# whose checkpoint was rescued without one beside it.
ENTRIES="
v1|$K/wgan-synthetic/x100k_ema_only/best_generator.pt|$K/wgan-synthetic/x100k_ema_only/run_config.yaml
v1_5|$K/wgan-synthetic/x100k_improved/best_generator.pt|$K/wgan-synthetic/x100k_improved/run_config.yaml
v2|$K/wgan-sparse-v2/x100k_sparse_clamp4/best_generator.pt|$K/wgan-sparse-v2/x100k_sparse_clamp4/run_config.yaml
v3|$K/v3-structured/x100k_structured-best_generator.pt|docs/results/v3-structured/x100k_structured/run_config.yaml
v4|$K/v34-sift1m/v4_x100k/best_generator.pt|$K/v34-sift1m/v4_x100k/run_config.yaml
"
ARGS=""
for e in $ENTRIES; do
  n=$(echo "$e" | cut -d"|" -f1); ck=$(echo "$e" | cut -d"|" -f2); cf=$(echo "$e" | cut -d"|" -f3)
  if [ -f "$ck" ] && [ -f "$cf" ]; then
    sed 's/^device: .*/device: cpu/' "$cf" > "$O/${n}_cpu.yaml"
    python -m src.sample.generate --checkpoint "$ck" --config "$O/${n}_cpu.yaml"       --num-samples 20000 --seed 7 --output-path "$O/samples_$n.npy"
    ARGS="$ARGS --synthetic-path $n=$O/samples_$n.npy"
    echo "INCLUDED $n"
  else
    echo "SKIPPED $n (ckpt=$([ -f $ck ] && echo Y || echo N) cfg=$([ -f $cf ] && echo Y || echo N))"
  fi
done
python -m src.eval.eda_report --real-path /workspace/data-cache/sift_1m.npy $ARGS   --output-dir "$O/eda" --ann-k 100 --ann-hub-k 10 --ann-max-rows 20000 --ivf-nlist 256
echo "=== 100K LADDER EDA DONE ==="
